description: Defines the EmployeeAttachment entity class for ORM, representing employee attachment records with properties like description, filename, size, attachment data, and related metadata, including constants for different screen contexts.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's attachment, including metadata such as description, filename, size, attachment content, type, screen context, and audit info.
